summary: Record the accepted design for independent MKM and KMC engines, conditional cross-validation and optional reactor modeling.

payload.markdown: - On 2026-11-21 the researcher accepted independent, separately approved CATKINAS MKM and Zacros KMC routes selected by SPC. Cross-validation is conditional on observable comparability. Reactor modeling is optional and requires validated macroscopic species sources. B.1 native normalization, stoichiometric sources and strict version isolation apply. [Architecture decision](decisions/adaptive_mkm_kmc_optional_reactor.md)
